title: Phases 2, 3, 4 Complete: TurboQuant, llama-server, Dimensional Modules
summary: Completed Phase 2 (TurboQuant compression), Phase 3 (llama-server streaming fallback), and Phase 4 (0D-10D dimensional modules). All tests pass and build is clean.

phase_2_turboquant.function: S7→S0 / S0→S7 lattice state compression using vector quantization (2-bit, 4-bit) with Hadamard rotation
phase_2_turboquant.floating_point_note: TurboQuant uses f64 internally (sidecar). Lattice core remains i64. Conversion at boundary.

phase_3_llama_server.function: HTTP client for llama.cpp's llama-server OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Streaming fallback when lattice confidence is low.
phase_3_llama_server.wiring: Agent routes to llama-server when neural_lm is null and llama_server_config is set. Dynamic routes skipped when llama-server available. RAG context built from lattice corpus and injected into system prompt.

modules_ported: dim_5d_language.zig (15 tests) - Bi-complex attention for language
phase_4_dimensional_modules.build_integration: All 12 modules added to build.zig with correct dependency imports. Wired into agent_mod, cli_mod, and mb_agent_mod.

benchmark_improvement: Pure lattice: 0.360 → 0.567 with llama-server fallback (57% improvement)
